name: Toake Rin
source:
Rin is an attentive and amiable housewife. She is gentle and a bit absent-minded, but she is easily influenced (especially when it comes to matters of chastity), and lacks a sense of danger.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ01278744.html]DLsite[/url]]
